items.title: Refund a tuition deposit to a withdrawn applicant
items.description: Return a deposit to an applicant who withdraws before the term starts.
items.body:
# When to use this

An applicant withdraws before the term starts and asks for their deposit back.

# Steps

1. Find the deposit in NetSuite by student ID.
2. Check the payment date against the 30-day window.
3. Create a refund against the original payment method.
4. Set the enrollment status in Salesforce to Withdrawn.
